scope: All eight change files including final spec.md, appended product-contract section 70–74 and current ROADMAP wording. Existing empirical roadmap statements are context, not independently revalidated implementation evidence.

caveats.finding: C2 funded positive witness is an example, not a funded-only language restriction; design and parent clarification preserve unfunded conditional submission.
MPLR vault drafts and register are outside this file-bound review; root reports the corresponding MPLR-010 correction will be propagated. No implementation, proof or ledger completion is established.

implementation_claim: None: this is documentation review, not proof, compiler, deployment or financial acceptance.

resolved_findings.finding: Positive scenario retains an unresolved external duty unless cancellation or nonexecution is established, omitting established successful delivery. This can force a known settled outcome into unresolved state, contrary to the common candidate. Negative scenario should also classify known success according to available evidence.
resolved_findings.required_change: Retain unresolved external duties until reliable evidence establishes relevant delivery, cancellation, nonexecution or recovery outcome, while preserving any other residual duties. Reject timeout-only nonexecution claims without discarding already established outcomes.
resolved_findings.resolution: Re-read corrected MPLR-010: reliable delivery/cancellation/nonexecution/recovery outcomes now discharge the appropriate uncertainty while preserving other residual duties. Negative outcome uses available authenticated evidence.
